Rows of matsetup that materialise a free population parameter

Source: R/ctMatsetup.R
dot-ctMatsetupFreeRows.Rd

The shared predicate behind every "which parameters are there" question asked of `matsetup`. Returns a logical vector the length of `nrow(ms)`.

Usage

.ctMatsetupFreeRows(
  ms,
  when = c(0, -1),
  defining = FALSE,
  varying = FALSE,
  free = TRUE
)

Arguments

ms

matsetup, as a data.frame.

when

which `when` values count. The default `c(0, -1)` is the population rows. Pass `c(0, 100)` to include the PARS wildcard – and only where the wildcard is genuinely wanted, since a PARS row's number is not a parameter number in the same sense.

defining

if TRUE, keep only the row that defines a parameter, not a row that copies it (`copyrow < 1`).

varying

if TRUE, keep only parameters that vary over subjects, by a TI predictor or a random effect.

free

if TRUE (the default), require `param > 0`. `nparams` is the one caller that wants the numbering range rather than the free rows, and it takes `free = FALSE` because a fixed row still carries a valid number.

Value

logical vector, `nrow(ms)` long.
